name: site-audit-tool
description: Automated website audit tool with performance, SEO, accessibility, and conversion checks

scripts.quality:scan: npm run build:qualityhub && node dist/qualityhub/cli/index.js scan
scripts.quality:gate: npm run build:qualityhub && node dist/qualityhub/cli/index.js gate
scripts.quality:baseline: npm run build:qualityhub && node dist/qualityhub/cli/index.js baseline
scripts.test:smells: npm run build:qualityhub && node -r ts-node/register tests/smell-test-harness.ts
